name: ALTEREDBLOOD+ [AB+]
description:
About This Game

BECKON OUR EXTINCTION

3242 CE:

We launched MOTHER, a self-replicating megastructure towards the galactic centre.

4,199,245,344,263,242,348,389,893,582,349,373 CE:

MOTHER has consumed 99.99999997% of the Observable Universe.

The remnants of humanity dwell in the remaining space, harvesting and living off MOTHER’s blood.

MOTHER created you to stop them.

BLOOD = SAP

ALTEREDBLOOD+ (AB+) is a fast-paced Movement-FPS about Painting levels in your enemies’ Blood, awakening your weapon’s abilities, and using their unique interactions with Blood to create powerful setups and combinations.

SPLATTER | SOAK | AWAKEN

SPLATTER 

  • Your attacks blast SAP onto surfaces behind enemies. Enemies explode into Gibs, spreading more SAP. Saturate the arena with SAP.

SOAK

  • Stand in their SAP or Bathe in their Gibs to awaken your weapons and abilities.

AWAKEN

  • Escalate the slaughter: when Awakened, your weapons gain powerful effects and unique interactions with SAP.

FEED

  • FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEED MOTHER, MOTHER IS HUNGRY, FEE-

WEAPONS

  • More details coming soon!

MOVEMENT SHOOTER

Inspired by movement tech in classic FPS in Source Engine games and Quake, ALTEREDBLOOD+ features a wide range of techniques to learn and master: B-hopping, Air-Strafing, Surfing, Trimping, Rocket jumping, etc.

  • Modernised controls are available as settings.

GAMEMODES

  • More details coming soon!

COMMUNITY

We're a brood of passionate artists, designers, and developers. Say hi! We don't bite unless you want us to :>
short_desc: SPLATTER your enemies, SOAK in their blood, AWAKEN your weapons, bring directionality to your ultraviolence in ALTEREDBLOOD+, a Movement-FPS Platformer.
